/residences/corner-residence.description: The Corner Residence at Skyline is a two bedroom home wrapped in glass, with a terrace that turns the corner over Brickell Bay. See the plan and book a viewing.
p: Two bedrooms wrapped in two walls of glass, with a terrace that turns the corner.
Corner homes see the bay and the city at once. Two walls of floor to ceiling glass meet at the living room, and a wraparound terrace follows them around the corner.
The primary suite faces the water, the second bedroom faces the skyline. Both have their own bath, and a separate powder room keeps guests out of the private side of the home.

/residences/penthouse.description: The Penthouse at Skyline is one home per floor at the top of the tower, with terraces on all four sides and a private lift. Request the plan and a viewing.
p: One home per floor, with a terrace on all four sides and a private lift that opens inside.

A grand salon, a library and a dining room for twelve sit at the centre of the plan. Four bedroom suites surround them, and every penthouse can be finished to the owner’s own design.

/residences/sky-residence.description: The Sky Residence at Skyline is a three bedroom home on floors 35 to 48, with bay and skyline views across the full width. See the plan and book a viewing.

/.title: Skyline Residences | Private homes above Brickell Bay
/.description: Skyline is a 52 floor residential tower on Brickell Bay, Miami, with 108 private homes facing the water. Explore the residences and book a private viewing.
h1: Private residences above Brickell Bay, shaped around privacy, service and the quiet that a city rarely gives.
h2: Skyline is a residence for people who measure luxury in light, silence and time, not in square feet.
Four ways to live above the bay
Forty thousand square feet for slow days
A hotel team, without the hotel
Brickell, at the quiet end of the bay
“We drew Skyline from the inside out. Every floor starts with where the light falls at five in the afternoon.”
We saw eleven towers before Skyline. It was the only one where the sales team talked about light before price.
p: Fifty two floors and one hundred and eight homes. Every one of them faces the water.
Scroll to rise with the tower

Designed by a studio known for quiet buildings, Skyline rises fifty two floors from a landscaped podium on Brickell Bay. Floor to ceiling glass, deep terraces and a private arrival court keep the city close and the noise far away.
Private residences, never more than three on a floor
From a one bedroom pied à terre to a full floor penthouse, every residence has a private lift lobby and a terrace that faces the water.
Plans are indicative. Layouts and areas vary by floor.
Skyline is planned in four groups of floors, each with its own residence type and view. Select a band on the tower to see what is available today.
Four private levels, one arrival court and a team that knows every owner by name. Every space is for residents and their guests only.
Level 1, arrival court. Level 9, pool deck. Level 10, spa and fitness. Level 51, sky club.
A private drive under royal palms, valet at the door, a concierge desk that never closes and a lobby that feels more like a home than a hotel.
Valet, concierge, package room, owners lounge
A seventy five foot pool facing the bay, shaded cabanas and a bar that opens at noon and closes when the last owner does.
Bay pool, cabanas, pool bar, sun terrace
Treatment rooms, a hammam and cold plunge, and a fitness studio where every machine looks out over the water.
Spa, hammam, cold plunge, fitness studio
A residents only lounge, private dining room and wine cellar near the top of the tower, open from breakfast until late.
Skyline is run by a resident team of thirty four, trained in five star hotels and led by an estate manager who lives on site.
Restaurant tables, flights, florists and the small things in between, handled by a team that knows your preferences.
Travel and dining bookings. Florists and gifts. Errands while you are away.
Your car waiting at the door, guests met by name and parcels taken up before you are home.
Valet at the arrival court. Guest lists and access. Electric car charging.
Daily, weekly or before you arrive, booked in a few taps and always by the same small team.
Daily or weekly service. Laundry and pressing. Pre arrival preparation.
Menus from the sky club kitchen, served at your own table on your own terrace.
Sky club menus. Private chef on request. Cellar service.
Owner berths at the neighbouring marina, with a team that looks after the boat as well as the home.
Berths by arrangement. Boat handling. Water taxi to Key Biscayne.
Skyline sits on Brickell Bay Drive, a short walk from the financial district and a few minutes from the beaches of Key Biscayne.
